answer.justification: Every logit-level measurement is exactly at its identity value: top-1 agreement 1.000, sequence agreement 1.000, KL 0.000, TV 0.000, Token-DiFR gap 0.000, and the raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0). Quantized models show KL 0.039 or higher and top-1 agreement of at most 0.955. Fine-tuned and system-prompted models show larger shifts still. Output and activation levels were not measured, but any tampering would produce non-zero logit differences, so the unknown model is the reference itself.
